principle: Recover or explicitly resolve every valuable capability; do not reproduce every historical repository.

dimensions.requirement: Selected behavior executes through authentic source and canonical destination runtimes with output and failure parity.
Recovered workflows produce accepted artifacts in at least three authentic uses across distinct inputs or days.
Each capability has one canonical state owner and runtime; duplicate writers are frozen or retired only with owner approval.
Critical gates run from a documented clean environment and preserve exact source, dependency, input, and output fingerprints.
Interruptions, retries, rollback, partial state, and resumability are tested without manufacturing success.
Sources, versions, authorship, approvals, side effects, and retirement decisions remain traceable and owner-controlled.
CLI, API, dashboard, manifests, evidence, and documentation distinguish plans, prototypes, recoveries, adoption, and convergence.
